title: Dot To Dot Festival 2017 – Second wave of bands announced
content:
1st April 2017

Dot to Dot returns to Bristol this Spring Bank Holiday weekend for its twelfth annual festival and it promises to be yet another extravaganza of live music from some of the best up and coming talent around. With last year’s event boasting an incredible 160 acts playing on 20 stages across 15 venues around the city, music fans are sure to be spoilt for choice once again as the ever expanding beast of Dot To Dot continues to evolve.

A second wave of acts has just been added to a line up that includes headliners Sundara Karma, Amber Run and The Growlers and many more acts will be announced in the weeks to come. It’s time for music fans to start delving headlong into their musical research in order to get the most out of this year’s fiesta of bands and artists.

Stay tuned for our full festival preview which will include an overview of some of the best acts to look out for at Dot To Dot 2017.

For tickets and more information about this year’s festival, visit the official Dot To Dot website.
